Contract CoCoMESystem::closeStore(storeID:Integer): Boolean {
          definition:
          store:Store = Store.allInstance()->any(s | s.Id = storeID)
            
            precondition:
          not store.oclIsUndefined() and store.IsOpened
            
            postcondition:
          let result:Boolean in if not store.oclIsUndefined() and store.IsOpened then store.IsOpened = false and result = true else result = false endif
            
        }
